prompt:
BEGIN PROMPT

PLAN 05 | ONE SMALL ORDER

DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES

{{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}  {{CHAR_GUARDS}}  {{CHAR_SHIP_CREW}}

LOCATION REFERENCES

{{LOC_SHIP_COMMAND_LANDING}}  {{LOC_DOCK_RAMP}}

PROP REFERENCES

{{PROP_ZAHHAK_SHIP}}  {{PROP_ZAHHAK_STAFF}}

DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Zahhak remains unhurried and indifferent. Whenever he walks, show the staff planting first, weight transferring onto it, then the weaker leg following in an uneven step. Preserve the reference's weak-leg side. His two single-headed shoulder snakes remain alive, making small independent movements; preserve their attachment and proportions.

LOCATION AND LIGHT

Full night, cold recessed deck lights and faint shore spill. An overhead deck practical reveals Zahhak's mask edge and staff while leaving deep shadow behind him. The elevated landing overlooks a broad downward ramp toward the quay.

START STATE AND BLOCKING

The ship is moored and its ramp is securely deployed. Zahhak starts one pace behind the upper rail. Four guards wait near the upper ramp entrance. Ship crew remain at mooring stations. Zahhak stays on the upper level throughout.


PLAN 05 | SHOTS

SHOT 05-01 | 0s–6s | 6 SECONDS

28mm low-angle full figure from below the landing. Zahhak takes two slow uneven steps toward the rail: staff plants first, body weight settles onto it, the weaker leg follows. Preserve the weak-leg side shown by the character reference. His living shoulder snakes make small independent neck and scale movements. The camera moves only a few centimeters closer.

SHOT 05-02 | 6s–9s | 3 SECONDS

50mm low oblique medium from the ramp side. Keeping his weight supported on the planted staff, Zahhak makes one small free-hand gesture toward the city. His head barely turns. The nearest guard immediately pivots toward the ramp.

SHOT 05-03 | 9s–15s | 6 SECONDS

24mm from the quay at the foot of the ramp, angled upward. Four guards descend rapidly from the upper landing toward camera, then pass toward the market entrance. Zahhak remains high in the background, still and supported by his staff. Camera steps aside with the passing guards, retaining the height difference.

END STATE AND EDIT

Four guards have reached the quay and move toward the night market. Zahhak remains aboard at the elevated landing. A later off-screen transfer takes him to the coastal residence.

SOUND

Staff taps, uneven measured steps, then faster coordinated guard boots on metal, with water and ship mechanisms underneath.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

END PROMPT
